name: pho-algorithmic-audit
description: Solve Public Health Observatory (PHO) "registered algorithmic audit" tasks: a prompt plus an analysis_request.json and answer_template.json that ask you to build cohorts from a read-only health/socioeconomic data portal and run a registered multi-module statistical audit (fixed-effects/GMM jackknife, nested ridge/elastic-net CV, wild cluster bootstrap-t, split conformal, trajectory PCA+k-means stability, source/feature perturbation) into one strict JSON object. Use when a task references the PHO portal, a six-module robustness/transport audit, registered final-release resolution, cohorts, and a controlled decision.

findings.excerpt: import csv, io, collections, urllib.request, urllib.parse
